projectContext: Sprint 6 focuses on caption system hardening, observability, and integration. Sprint 5 delivered parallel fetching, live stream detection, language fallback chains, coverage metrics, partial recovery, format preferences, timestamp validation, pre-check, streaming progress, and fixture health checks. Sprint 6 advances: (1) Thread safety under high concurrency, (2) Per-video timeout tracking and batch resilience, (3) Language selection audit trails, (4) Format success rate telemetry, (5) Configuration validation at startup, (6) Caption quality impact on match confidence, (7) Timing validation precision, (8) Cross-project cache validation, (9) Normalizer edge case handling, (10) Integration test coverage for end-to-end quality flow.

userStories.title: Add thread-safe locking to streaming progress callback
userStories.description: With 8+ parallel workers calling the progress callback simultaneously, concurrent updates to TTY output can produce garbled lines. Add thread synchronization to ensure clean output under high concurrency.
acceptanceCriteria: Add threading.Lock to CaptionStage progress callback protecting TTY writes
Protect last_line_length state variable with the same lock
Create test simulating 8 concurrent workers calling on_progress simultaneously
Verify output remains readable without garbled lines or character overlaps
Add docstring documenting thread-safety guarantees for progress_callback
Performance test confirms lock adds <5ms overhead per callback
userStories.notes: Implemented threading.Lock (progress_lock) in on_progress callback. All TTY writes and last_line_length state are now protected under 'with progress_lock:'. Added TestProgressCallbackThreadSafety class with 4 tests: concurrent callbacks (16 vids, 8 workers), state protection, <5ms overhead verification, TTY serialization. Tests verify no garbled output, no deadlocks, avg timing well under 5ms. Files: src/stages/caption_stage.py, tests/test_stage_caption.py

userStories.title: Implement per-video timeout tracking in batch fetch
userStories.description: Currently batch fetch has a single timeout; no visibility into which specific video caused a timeout or how long each video took. Add granular timing data for debugging slow fetches.
acceptanceCriteria: Track start_time and elapsed_seconds for each video in fetch_single()
Add elapsed_seconds to progress_callback details dict
Log warning if individual video takes >80% of timeout threshold
Add CaptionMetrics method get_slowest_videos(n=5) returning video_ids by fetch time
Print summary in CaptionStage: 'Slowest fetches: abc123=8.2s, def456=7.1s'
Tests verify timing data captured correctly for 10+ video batch

userStories.title: Add language selection audit trail to metrics
userStories.description: When fallback_languages is configured, users have no visibility into why a specific language was selected for each video. Add detailed tracing to debug multilingual projects.
acceptanceCriteria: Add language_selection_trace: List[Dict] field to CaptionMetrics
Each trace entry includes: video_id, attempted_codes, selected_code, selection_reason
Print trace summary in CaptionStage: 'Language fallback: 15 preferred, 8 fallback-1, 2 fallback-2'
Add method get_language_fallback_efficiency() returning % using preferred language
Trace entries include whether manual or auto captions were selected
Tests verify trace captures full decision chain for multi-fallback scenario

userStories.title: Track format preference success rates in metrics
userStories.description: Users configure preferred_formats but cannot see if their preference is actually being honored. Add telemetry showing which formats succeed most often.
acceptanceCriteria: Add format_success_counts: Dict[str, int] to CaptionMetrics tracking successes per format
Track format_fallback_count: number of videos that needed format != first preference
Add method get_format_statistics() returning success rate per format
Print in CaptionStage summary: 'Format success: json3 92% (92/100), vtt 8% (fallback)'
Track which format ultimately succeeded for each video in fetch result
Tests verify statistics calculated correctly across batch with mixed format results

userStories.title: Validate language configuration at CaptionStage initialization
userStories.description: Invalid language codes in fallback_languages or duplicates between preferred and fallback chain cause silent failures during fetch. Add startup validation for fail-fast behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Add validate_language_config() method checking all language codes are valid ISO 639-1
Detect and warn if preferred_language appears in fallback_languages chain
Detect and error on duplicate entries within fallback_languages
Call validation in CaptionStage.__init__() before first fetch
Invalid codes raise ConfigValidationError with clear message and suggestion
Tests verify validation catches: invalid codes, duplicates, preferred-in-fallback

userStories.title: Apply caption quality weights to match confidence scores
userStories.description: Auto-generated captions have lower accuracy than manual captions but currently affect match confidence equally. Add configurable weights that reduce confidence for lower quality captions.
acceptanceCriteria: Add caption_quality_weights config to MatchConfig: {high: 1.0, medium: 0.9, low: 0.75}
MatchStage applies weight to raw confidence: adjusted = raw * quality_weight
Log confidence adjustments: 'Confidence adjusted 0.85 -> 0.64 (low quality caption)'
CaptionResult quality flows through text_metadata to MatchStage
Add config option matching.apply_caption_quality_weights (default: true)
Tests verify same match text produces different confidence with high vs low quality

userStories.title: Add timing epsilon tolerance to validate_timing method
userStories.description: Floating-point precision can cause captions ending at 299.999s in a 300s video to be flagged as timing issues. Add configurable epsilon tolerance for boundary cases.
acceptanceCriteria: Add timing_epsilon_ms parameter to validate_timing() (default: 100.0)
Captions ending within epsilon of video duration treated as valid, not exceeding
TimingValidationResult includes timing_epsilon_applied field showing value used
Config option caption_first.timing_epsilon_ms for project-level override
Document epsilon rationale in validate_timing docstring
Tests verify: 300.05s caption in 300s video valid with 100ms epsilon, invalid with 10ms

userStories.title: Add cross-project caption cache validation
userStories.description: When caption_first.cache_captions=true, corrupted data from one project can silently propagate to others. Add validation that checks cached data integrity before use.
acceptanceCriteria: Add cache entry validation checking (video_id, language, segment_count) consistency
Add config option caption_first.cache_validation: 'strict'|'warn'|'skip' (default: 'warn')
In strict mode: reject cache if segment_count differs >20% from expected
In warn mode: log warning and re-fetch on validation failure
Track cache_validation_results in metrics: {passed: N, rejected: M, refetched: K}
Tests verify cached captions rejected when language or count mismatch detected

userStories.title: Handle normalizer edge cases for corrupted segments
userStories.description: The CaptionNormalizer handles basic corruption but lacks tests for edge cases like negative durations, overlapping segments with text merge, and segment index conflicts.
acceptanceCriteria: Add test: segment with start=-5, end=2 fixed to start=0, end>=min_duration
Add test: segment with negative duration (start > end) gets swapped or skipped
Add test: overlapping segments (0-5, 3-8) merged with concatenated text
Add test: duplicate segment indices re-indexed sequentially
Add test: gap > max_gap creates placeholder segment preserving timing
Document all edge case behaviors in CaptionNormalizer docstring with examples

userStories.title: Create integration test for caption quality impact on matching
userStories.description: No end-to-end test verifies that caption quality metadata flows through to match confidence. Add comprehensive integration test validating the full pipeline path.
acceptanceCriteria: Create TestCaptionQualityMatchIntegration class in tests/test_caption_match_integration.py
Test: mock low-quality auto-generated captions flow to MatchStage with quality='low'
Test: match confidence differs for same text when quality is 'high' vs 'low'
Test: final OTIO segments include caption_quality metadata for downstream filtering
Test verifies quality weights config correctly applied (if US-006 implemented)
Document test as integration smoke test for caption-to-match quality pipeline
